scope: Fixed pre-collection operator qualification budget for a NEW half-QKV numerical policy, not the original FP32 contract and not model quality proof.
reference: FP64 exact causal softmax of Q/K/V rounded once to IEEE half (ties to even), with original controls/gate.
full_control_bound: base + relative*max(abs(V_half)) + additive*visible*max(abs(V_half)); compare raw candidate to half-rounded-input four-MPS reference
derivation: Half conversion error <= 2^-11*x + 2^-25, divided by probability scale32768. Two half components leave <= 2^-22*x + 2*2^-40. Online rescale factors <=1; final denominator >=1; weighted sum of absolute V bounds the normalized error. The existing FP32 allowance remains the empirical float-math check; this is not a universal proof of hardware roundoff.
failures: Preserve original FP32-contract failure counts separately. If this fixed new-policy budget fails, reject; do not tune from outputs.
